frame_story: King Shahryar marries and executes virgin each night; Shahrazad tells stories to delay death for 1001 nights, ending with King's forgiveness

stories.title: Story Of King Shahryar and His Brother
stories.full_story: King Shahryar, ruler of Persia and India, discovers his wife's infidelity and executes her. Embittered, he marries a new virgin each night and executes her at dawn. His brother Shahzaman had similar fate. Vizier's daughter Shahrazad, learned in books and stories, volunteers to marry the king, with plan to tell stories and postpone execution. With her sister Dunyazad, she begins tales that last 1001 nights, each ending on cliffhanger.

stories.full_story: A merchant stops to eat dates and throws pits, accidentally killing a Jinni's son. Jinni appears demanding death. Merchant begs leave to settle affairs and returns. On his way, he meets three old Shaykhs each with an animal. They bargain with Jinni by telling wondrous tales, each tale buying one-third of merchant's blood. After three stories, Jinni forgives merchant.

stories.title: The Fisherman and the Jinni
stories.full_story: A poor fisherman casts net four times. Fourth time he pulls brass jar sealed with Solomon's seal. Opens it, huge Jinni emerges, threatens to kill fisherman because after centuries imprisoned he vowed to kill liberator. Fisherman tricks Jinni by doubting jar could hold him, Jinni re-enters to prove, fisherman seals jar again. Later Jinni bargains, leads fisherman to lake with colored fish. Fisherman sells fish to king, king discovers city turned to stone, etc. Contains sub-tales of Wazir and Sage Duban, King Sindibad and Falcon, Husband and Parrot, Prince and Ogress.

stories.title: The Porter and the Three Ladies of Baghdad
stories.full_story: A porter helps a lady shop, is invited to house of three sisters. They feast, but make him swear not to ask about what they do. Three Kalandars (wandering princes with shaved beards and lost eyes) knock. Ladies admit them with same oath. Then Caliph Harun al-Rashid in disguise with Jafar and executioner Masrur knocks, also admitted. Ladies beat dogs and weep, beat lutes. Porter and guests ask meaning. Ladies explain their histories: first lady was beaten by demon, second lady's tale, portress tale. Kalandars tell their tales. Caliph reveals himself and marries sisters.

stories.title: The Hunchback's Tale
stories.full_story: A tailor's hunchback chokes on fishbone and appears dead. Tailor and wife carry body to doctor's house, doctor trips over body, thinks he killed, drops body in steward's house, steward thinks thief etc. Body passes to many hands: Christian broker, etc. Each thinks he killed hunchback. Finally brought before king, each confesses. Barber called to examine, finds fishbone, removes, hunchback revives. King orders tale recorded. Contains Nazarene Broker's Story, Reeve's Tale, Jewish Doctor, Tailor, Barber's six brothers.
